name: collatz_level_contraction

phase_0.boundary_condition: The predecessor tree level L_k and its image L_{k+1} under the inverse Collatz map, bounded by the modulus 3^r where the two residue bijections (doubling and odd-lift) operate.

⊢.justification: The state before any nodes are generated at level k, representing the void set from which the tree grows.

⊣.justification: The closed set of nodes at depth k, serving as the boundary condition for the next iteration.

≻.justification: The forward morphism m -> 2m, which maps every node in L_k to a unique even node in L_{k+1}.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism m -> (2m-1)/3, which maps nodes m ≡ 2 (mod 3) in L_k to odd nodes in L_{k+1}, representing the descent into the 3-adic structure.

⋈.justification: The composition of the doubling image and the odd-lift image to form the complete set L_{k+1}.

⊙.justification: The self-reference of the residue class modulo 3^r, ensuring the bijection properties hold within the ring.

∈.justification: Splits the level L_k into two arms: the full set for doubling and the subset m ≡ 2 (mod 3) for the odd lift.

∋.justification: Rejoins the two arms to compute the total count of L_{k+1} as |L_k| + |L_k ∩ {2 mod 3}|.

⊤.justification: The affirmative state where the fraction of nodes at 2 mod 3 converges to 1/3, yielding the 4/3 branch factor.

⊥.justification: The negative state representing the measured deviation from uniformity, which decays geometrically but is strictly non-zero at finite k.

⊞.justification: The paradice state holding both the theoretical 4/3 limit and the measured deviation simultaneously, as the system is not yet uniform.

⊡.justification: The permanent record of the maximum deviation at level k, which bounds the deviation at level k+1 by a factor strictly below one.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: No nodes exist at the current level; the tree has not started.
phase_3.true_description: The level is perfectly uniform modulo 3^r, and the branch factor is exactly 4/3.
phase_3.false_description: The level exhibits a measurable deviation from uniformity, and the branch factor is strictly less than 4/3.
phase_3.both_description: The level is simultaneously approaching the 4/3 limit (true) and retaining a specific non-zero deviation (false), held in the mixing gap.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the empty set for level k.
Anchor the system at the current level L_k.
Split L_k into the full set for doubling and the subset m ≡ 2 (mod 3) for the odd lift.
Apply the doubling map m -> 2m to the full set, generating the even nodes of L_{k+1}.
Apply the odd lift m -> (2m-1)/3 to the subset m ≡ 2 (mod 3), generating the odd nodes of L_{k+1}.
Compose the even and odd images to form the complete set L_{k+1}.
Assert the residue identity modulo 3^r for the new level.
Evaluate the affirmative state where the fraction of 2 mod 3 nodes is 1/3.
Evaluate the negative state where the deviation from 1/3 is non-zero.
Hold the mixing gap where both the limit and the deviation coexist.
Record the maximum deviation at level k as a permanent bound.
Rejoin the arms to compute the cardinality of L_{k+1} and the new deviation bound.
Chain the new level to the next iteration, carrying the deviation bound forward.
Fix the new deviation bound, which is strictly less than the previous bound by a factor below one.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The inverse Collatz map logic that translates residue classes into tree levels.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The residue bijections (doubling and odd-lift) that communicate between levels.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The set of nodes at each level, stored as a finite set of integers.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The depth-first traversal of the predecessor tree, level by level.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Lean module CollatzDepthSplit.lean, which proves the bijection properties and the deviation bounds.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One 3-adic digit of resolution per level, consumed by the mixing process.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Level k with a specific deviation from uniformity.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Level k+1 with a strictly smaller deviation from uniformity.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is entropy-conservative because the deviation decays geometrically, preserving the total information content while approaching the uniform limit.
